text:
Alex: Heads-up — live all-hands audio just dropped, OBS shows no mic input. Can ops triage?
StreamBot: Alert: audio channel lost at 14:17:03 UTC, encoder heartbeats healthy.
Sam: I'm on it. Trying quick re-route to iso-mic-2. Might be 20-40s of silence while we flip.
Maria: If audio is down longer than 30s let's put up a caption-only slide and delay the Q&A. @Jon @Priya FYI.
Priya: Acknowledged. Jon, hold Q&A until we confirm a stable audio track or we'll move questions to chat.
Jon: Got it. Will collect questions but not start live Q&A. Pin the top three when we go live.
Alex: Posting to attendees: "Brief pause for audio fix — we'll be back in under 2 minutes." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam: Reroute complete, OBS now shows levels on iso-mic-2 but there's a slight clipping artifact. Routing to backup encoder. Command I ran: `ffmpeg -f alsa -i hw:2 -ac 2 -ar 48000 -f flv rtmp://backup-encoder/live`
StreamBot: Failover: switched to backup-encoder-7, added +3s latency.
Maria: Can we record both iso tracks and the main board so we can splice if one clip is bad?
Sam: Starting parallel capture to s3://redwood-recordings/allhands/4301209876/iso2.wav and main_board.wav; tagging with encoder and mic metadata.
Priya: Action item: ops to add auto-switch when drop detected for >0.5s. Filing ticket INF-8422.
Alex: Once stream green, resume and we'll take leadership Qs. Jon collect from #all-hands-chat and pin top three.
Jon: Will pin once StreamBot shows "healthy".
Maria: Requesting post-meeting clips for pre-drop, during, and post-fix to check STT quality.
Sam: Uploading clips now, ETA ~4m.
StreamBot: Recording resumed; incident duration 00:02:02, status: degraded->healthy.
Alex: Thanks team. Please include which encoder and mic used in the meeting notes and link INF-8422.
Priya: Note for follow-ups: add a small blurb in runbook about announcing brief pauses to attendees to reduce confusion.
Alex: Copy. Leaving thread open until clips are attached and ticket linked.
Maria: Uploaded clips and linked in the notes. Also added a short transcript snippet showing where the clipping happened.
Sam: Confirmed INF-8422 created and assigned to @ops.
Jon: Pinned the top 3 chat questions. Ready to run Q&A when leadership gives the green light.
Alex: Resume in 30s to let captions sync, then hotseat Q&A.
Maria: Thanks all — good catch on the auto-fallback idea.
Alex: Closing after final uploads. :thumbsup:
